title: New Foods!
description: This is a mod that adds new foods to Minecraft
body:
# **New Foods**
This is a mod that implements more foods!
For now, we got:

1. Empanada
2. Arepa
3. Ceviche
4. Taco
5. Mate
6. Pizza
7. Paella
8. Sushi
9. Fish And Chips
10. Croissant

And soon, we are going to get so much more!

This is a mod in Beta, if you got any error, contact us! (Textures are in Beta too)

For any issues just send a mail to: superc839.ma@gmail.com
